title: About AI-Powered Recommendations for Application Segments

blocks.text: Private Access (ZPA) analyzes user logs and suggests AI-powered recommendations for application segments. AI-powered recommendations are application segments that have been pulled based on the filters you have configured in the AI-Powered Recommendations Settings. These AI-powered recommendations for application segments can be merged with existing defined application segments, added as newly defined application segments, or ignored if they do not apply.
AI-powered recommendations for application segments provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Discover and create new application segments based on application similarity or user behavior.
Find missing applications for existing application segments and easily merge them.
Accelerate your journey toward achieving Zero Trust for Private Access.

blocks.text: To learn more about the configuration options available for your applications before configuring an application segment for Private Access, see About Applications and Configuring AI-Powered Recommendations Settings.
The following prerequisites are required to activate the AI-Powered Recommendations page:

blocks.item: Have a minimum of 100 discovered applications.
Have at least 20 enrolled users.

blocks.text: To activate this feature, click Activate Recommendations on the AI-Powered Recommendations page.

The AI-Powered Recommendations page is only populated with data for users who have activated it. If you want to enable this feature and the AI-Powered Recommendations page is not displayed, contact Zscaler Support.
On the AI-Powered Recommendations page (Private Access > Private Applications > AI-Powered Recommendations), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Configure AI-powered recommendations settings.
Download a CSV file with all AI-powered recommended application segments.
Open the Settings drawer to add parameters to AI-powered recommended application segment findings.
Settings is replaced by AI-Powered Recommendations Settings depending on your subscription.
Show or hide filters to filter the information that appears in the table. By default, no filters are applied. To learn more, see Using Tables.
You can also search for specific recommendations from the list of available recommendations depending on your subscription.
Click Generate Recommendations to generate AI-powered recommendations. Hover over the button to view the Last Generated and Next Availability dates.

The Next Availability date and the ability to generate AI-powered recommendations are determined by your subscription. Generate Recommendations, Last Generated, and Next Availability are replaced by Refresh Recommendations, Last Refreshed, and Next Refresh Available On options depending on your subscription.
Clicking Generate Recommendations will overwrite any manually created recommendations.
View a list of all AI-powered recommendations that are configured for your organization.
View elements of each application segment.
Click an application in the Name column to open the Recommended Details drawer.
Attack Surface Reduction: The percentage reduction in the attack surface (i.e., percentage difference between potential users and recommended users).
Users: The number of users for the current configuration, the number of observed users, and the number of recommended users.
If SCIM Sync or SCIM Attributes for Policy is not enabled, the user recommendations appear as N/A.
See image.
Click any of the following pages to view additional details for the specific AI-powered recommendation depending on your subscription:
Hosts
Hosts: The host of the applications.
Configured Applications: The configured applications.
TCP Ports: The TCP port ranges used to access applications.
UDP Ports: The UDP port ranges used to access applications.
Resolve IP Address: The resolved IP address used to access applications.
Recommended Users
View By: Select Users or Groups to change how recommendations are displayed.
Recommended Users: The name of the recommended user for the AI-powered recommendation. Displays only when View By is set to Users.
Groups: When View By is set to Users, the group associated with each recommended user is displayed. When View By is set to Groups, the recommended groups are displayed.
Total Users: The total number of users in each recommended group. Displays only when View By is set to Groups.
Observed Users
View By: Select Users or Groups to change how recommendations are displayed.
Observed Users: The name of the observed user for the AI-powered recommendation.
Groups: When View By is set to Users, the group associated with each observed user is displayed. When View By is set to Groups, the observed groups are displayed.
Total Users: The total number of users in each observed group. Displays only when View By is set to Groups.
Click Accept to open the Accept Recommendation window. In the Accept Recommendation window, click Confirm to add the recommendation.
Name: The name of the application segment.

ASR: The percentage reduction in the attack surface (i.e., percentage difference between potential users and recommended users). The ASR includes the following operators: Equals (=), Greater Than (>), and Less Than (<). By default, the list is sorted in ascending order by ASR.
ASR is replaced by Attack Surface Reduction depending on your subscription.
Each AI-powered recommendation can contain the following additional elements depending on your subscription:
User Groups: The user groups of the application segment.
# of Hosts: The number of hosts for the application segment.
Policy Rule: The name of the policy rule for the application segment.
Server Group: The name of the server group for the application segment.
Application Types: The application types of the application segment (e.g., RDP, Apache HTTP Server, SMB).

If you click Ignore, you must select a reason in the Send Feedback window. Add additional comments if needed and click Submit. The ignored recommended application segment will no longer appear in the table. Click Cancel to cancel the ignore action. To view the list of ignored AI-powered recommended application segments, select the Ignored Recommendations filter.
The Diagnostics page shows up to 200 applications per recommended application segment. Any additional applications are not shown.
The availability of both the ignore functionality and the Diagnostics page for the recommended application segment depends on your subscription.

Before adding recommendations to application segments, ensure that Multimatch is enabled on the wildcard application segment. Failing to do so will trigger an error message prompting you to enable Multimatch on the selected wildcard application segment.

Add an AI-powered recommended application segment.

After you click Confirm, a pop-up message appears indicating that the application was added successfully. Additionally, the message also includes links to the newly added AI-recommended Application Segment and Policy.
See image.
View and explore available recommendations by category depending on your subscription.
View the available categories.

Total Recommendations: The total number of recommendations. Select Show All to view all available recommendations in the table. Under Attack Surface Reduction, select >75%–100% or 0%–75% to view the available recommendations in the table based on the selected percentage range.
If your organization has the Segmentation add-on license, you can request to update the total number of recommendations from 100 to 500.
Top Recommended User Groups: The top recommended user groups. Select a checkbox next to the recommended user groups to update the available recommendations in the table.

Top Observed Users: The top observed users that are sorted by different ranges of users (i.e., < 10 users, 30-20 users, 60-50 users, or > 60 users). Select a checkbox next to the observed users to update the available recommendations in the table.

Top Application Types: The top application types (e.g., RDP, Apache HTTP Server, SMB) of the recommendations. Select a checkbox next to the application types to update the available recommendations in the table.
